ImageDescription.value:
Detail of the central and southeastern San Fernando Valley, from a manuscript map of Los Angeles and San Bernardino topography, 1880, by William Hammond Hall, Office of the State Engineer, California.
  • The map shows Rancho Los Encinos or Rancho El Encino (lower left), Mission San Fernando Rey de España (center top), and the Tujunga River channels.
  • The Los Angeles River and its other tributaries are also shown.
